doc: Selects one of three player-stat halfword globals by an index argument: arg0==2 -> D_80084808[0], arg0==1 -> D_8008480A[0], arg0==4 -> D_8008480C[0], any other value -> 0. The control-flow shape (test ==2 first with the case2 body deferred to the very end of the function, then a range check arg0>=3 that skips to the "case 4" block, with each default-0 path either explicitly jumping to the shared return or being merged into a branch's delay slot) only reproduces byte-exact when written with explicit goto/labels forcing that exact block layout; equivalent nested-if / switch / ternary rewrites all diverge in branch polarity or block ordering even though they're logically identical.

globals.name: D_80084808
globals.decl: extern s16 D_80084808[8]; /* player-stat halfword array; index 0 read here; indices 0-2 written 0x7FFF by w_800559B4.c; already declared this way in include/globals.h and src/*.c */

globals.name: D_8008480A
globals.decl: extern s16 D_8008480A[8]; /* sibling stat array 2 bytes above D_80084808 in memory but declared/used as its own independent extern symbol elsewhere in the codebase (not offset into D_80084808); index 0 read here */

globals.name: D_8008480C
globals.decl: extern s16 D_8008480C[8]; /* sibling stat array, independent extern symbol (see src/code.c: D_8008480C[0] = arg0 setter); index 0 read here */
